answer: Staggered live triangulation starves shared controllers. Each epoch three non-kin peers fire presence probes at unpredictable offsets—say minute 4, 19, and 41—and the same sealed runtime must answer all three. On a mesa of clones one brain freezes when windows overlap; a lone sparrow clears every lagoon of timing gaps because it is only one process. Example: farm Q misses probe C whenever B collides.
